civilwar_apparent.flaw: apparent (in-sample) error reported as cross-validated: the CV-tuned, down-sampled random forest is scored on the same rows it was trained on (caret predict() without newdata)
civilwar_apparent.original_paper: Muchlinski, Siroky, He, Kocher (2016), Comparing Random Forest with Logistic Regression for Predicting Class-Imbalanced Civil War Onset Data, Political Analysis 24(1):87-103 (citation as given in the reanalysis' references; DOI not checked)
civilwar_apparent.original_claim: random forest ROC-AUC 0.91, 'cross-validated' (p. 96, fn. 7); superior predictive power vs logistic regression (p. 101)
civilwar_apparent.reanalysis: Neunhoeffer & Sternberg (2019), How Cross-Validation Can Go Wrong and What to Do About It, Political Analysis 27(1):101-106, doi:10.1017/pan.2018.39; author PDF https://sebastiansternberg.github.io/pdf/pa_cross_validation.pdf ; replication doi:10.7910/DVN/Y9KMJW

published_numbers.source_text: Section 4 and Online Appendix C.2: PR-AUC drops from 0.43 (Procedure 5, apparent error) to 0.07 (Procedure 6, train 1945-1989, test 1990-2000)

roc_auc_digitised_from_figure1_UNVERIFIE.note: read off vector glyph positions in Figure 1 lower panel; about +-0.01; not stated in text

civilwar_apparent.related_reanalysis_not_reproduced: Kapoor & Narayanan (2023), Leakage and the reproducibility crisis in ML-based science, Patterns 4(9):100804, arXiv:2207.07048, Table A1: train+test imputed together with rfImpute (outcome used); RF AUC reported 0.94 (reproduced 0.95), corrected 0.64. Not built: their raw pre-imputation data is only in CodeOcean capsule doi:10.24433/CO.4899453.v1, which returned HTTP 403 to automated download on 2026-11-01.
civilwar_apparent.data: SambnisImp.csv, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/KRKWK8 version 1.0, file id 2701491, md5 5e570898c1c9335c6eeb6515ec9c8a28 (the same file ships in the reanalysis replication zip). 90 predictors per the reanalysis code (R/reanalysis.R) + year + warstds.
civilwar_apparent.port_notes: Python port (sklearn 1.9.1): per-class down-sampled bagged trees (30 peace, 90 war per tree, with replacement, 300 trees vs 1000), mtry grid (2,46,90) tuned by 10-fold stratified CV ROC-AUC (caret default grid for 90 predictors); PR-AUC = sklearn average_precision_score (the reanalysis used aucPRp from Cranmer & Desmarais; small definitional differences).

civilwar_temporal_clean.flaw: none: the same pipeline trained on 1945-1989 and scored on 1990-2000 (the reanalysis's Procedure 6)

esl_selection.flaw: univariate screening of 100 of 5000 predictors on ALL samples before 5-fold CV of a 1-NN classifier
